name: chrome-in-harness
description: Browser MCP: control a real Chrome profile via a MV3 extension bridged to a local MCP server

scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @chrome-in-harness/protocol && npm run dev -w @chrome-in-harness/server
scripts.build:extension: npm run build -w @chrome-in-harness/protocol && npm run build -w @chrome-in-harness/extension
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chrome-in-harness/protocol && npm run build -w @chrome-in-harness/server && npm run build -w @chrome-in-harness/extension && npm run build -w @chrome-in-harness/launcher
scripts.test: npm run build -w @chrome-in-harness/protocol && npm run test -w @chrome-in-harness/protocol && npm run test -w @chrome-in-harness/server && npm run build -w @chrome-in-harness/extension && npm run test -w @chrome-in-harness/extension && npm run test -w @chrome-in-harness/launcher
scripts.typecheck:extension: npm run build:extension && npm exec -w @chrome-in-harness/extension -- tsc --noEmit
scripts.pack: npm run build && mkdir -p dist-release && npm pack -w @chrome-in-harness/protocol -w @chrome-in-harness/server -w @chrome-in-harness/launcher --pack-destination ./dist-release && npm run zip -w @chrome-in-harness/extension && cp packages/extension/.output/chrome-in-harness-*.zip dist-release/chrome-in-harness-extension.zip
